item.title: Ice climbing festival comes to Sault Ste. Marie
item.description: A new ice climbing festival offers adventure east and north of Sault Ste.Marie later this month. Ice Fest SSM runs Feb. 27 to March 1 at Gros Cap Bluffs and Searchmont Ice Wall, a release says. The event is presented by Alpine Club of Canada, Sault Ste. Marie. item.title: Council asks staff to explore opportunities to turn waste to energy
item.description: Ward 5 Coun. Corey Gardi wants to capitalize on decarbonizing heavy industry and expanding the bioeconomy, which is prioritized in both the provincial and federal governments' recent budgets.

item.title: Soo Greyhounds lead CHL with 4 players on top 50 list
item.description: Wayne Gretzky, Paul Coffey, Ron Francis and Joe Thornton headline the franchise’s contribution to the CHL’s best of the last 50 years.

item.title: Tenaris expands Canadian footprint with new western service centre
item.description: The western service centre receives steel pipes for the Sault Ste. Marie industrial centre, where all of Tenaris’s Canadian steel pipes are manufactured.
